title: Maul Drive Forward Together (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the maul is the rolling truck
Ball carrier upright, pack binds tight
Drive forward together, never split

[Verse 1]
Ball carrier stays on their feet, ball at the back
First arrival binds onto the carrier, attack
Forms the front of the maul, drives forward
More players bind on, drive toward

[Pre-Chorus]
The ball stays at the back of the maul
Protected by bodies, two layers tall
The maul moves forward five metres at a time
Then reset, then drive, then climb

[Chorus]
Maul drive forward together, son
Truck of bodies, the work begun
Ball at the back, drive at the front
Five metres at a time, never blunt

[Verse 2]
Lineout maul drives forward to the line
Catch and drive five metres, fine
Then split off the back, scrum half spins it wide
Or keep driving to the try line ride

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the maul is suffocating
For the defence, no one penetrating
Ten bodies bound, all driving as one
Ball hidden, ball protected, the work undone

[Chorus]
Maul drive forward together, son
Truck of bodies, the work begun
Ball at the back, drive at the front
Five metres at a time, never blunt

[Outro]
Drive together, ball at back
Front men low, push the track
Five metres, reset, drive again
Thats my boy, win again
